takeaways.text: Lines up **Slot** on **45%** of 304 plays (n=138); also Wide (outside) 32% (n=98).
Route on **97%** / blocks on **3%** of dropbacks (95% CI 95–99%, n=304) — 11 pts above the TE average of 86%.
On routes, averages **8.7 yd** downfield by the throw (n=295, snap→release window only).

Because he releases into a route on ~97% of dropbacks and most often from Slot, a coach might account for him as a receiver there rather than expecting help in protection — to be validated against film and matchup.

example_plays.why: closest to his median route depth (7.9 yd) — a normal rep
farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
